_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in your values. Do NOT commit config.json to version control.
_user_email_comment: The mailbox Rocky reads case folders from (James's mailbox with delegated access).
_rocky_email_comment: Rocky's own mailbox. Used as the sender for digest emails.
_cases_root_comment: Path to the Rocky Cases folder on OneDrive. Omit to use the default (James's dev laptop path).
_maple_digest_comment: Maple digest (--maple-digest, 7:00 PM — after the Maple Updater's ~4 PM run wrote the outbox file). Takes the updater's outbox\client_digest_YYYY-MM-DD.html and creates a DRAFT in maple_client_digest_mailbox's Drafts folder addressed to maple_client_digest_recipients (external addresses allowed — nothing is sent; James reviews and sends). The cc list is load-bearing: pma@bozzuto.com routes Beth's reply-all back into rocky@'s watched 'Inbox\PMA emails' folder, which is how typed answers reach the feed. Defaults IN CODE to the production outbox path, jbragdon@, and the Bozzuto+Gallagher lists set 2026-07-04. (Keys keep the maple_client_digest_ prefix: the retired internal digest used maple_digest_recipients for a firm-internal list.)
_maple_updater_comment: Path to the Maple updater's run-daily-update.ps1 (lives in the Maple OneDrive folder, not in Rocky). The dashboard's 'Maple Updater' button/schedule runs this script. Defaults IN CODE to the production path on the Rocky laptop (rocky profile); set this on machines where the Maple folder mounts elsewhere.
_remy_comment: Remy invocation paths. remy_cli_path is where remy_cli.py lives on disk. remy_outputs_path is where generated drafts get written.
_remy_delivery_comment: Email addresses that receive Remy draft delivery after generation.
_remy_digest_comment: Remy digest (--remy-digest — NO scheduled task since 2026-08-30: the Multifamily Digest generates it in-process at its 5:45 PM run and embeds it; the command remains for manual/off-cycle runs). Rocky reads the Remy repo over the GitHub API, summarizes the day's code commits and session notes in plain English, and commits digest/YYYY-MM-DD.md back to the repo. remy_github_token is a fine-grained PAT scoped to jbragdon21/remy with 'Contents: Read and write' — read-only cannot update the on-GitHub archive (no token = digest still builds from the OneDrive activity folder, just without commit history or the GitHub archive). remy_digest_recipients only matters for manual runs without --no-email; must be firm addresses. remy_digest_mailbox defaults to rocky_email.
_monitor_comment: The Monitor (--monitor, 24/7 at boot). Every monitor_interval_minutes it runs monitor_commands as subprocesses (own locks/cursors/failure isolation), so certified-mail requests, YES replies, and Vault submissions get handled within minutes. Honors ROCKY STOP. Disable the 8:00 AM letterstream and hourly vault-mail/vault-inbox schedule entries once this runs (overlap is lock-safe, just redundant). Heavier jobs (vault-dropbox, litigation --poll, digests) stay on their own schedules; add a flag here to fold one in without a rebuild.
_kill_switch_comment: Email addresses authorized to send ROCKY STOP / ROCKY START commands.
_pending_llt_comment: SharePoint config for the Pending LLT Matters pipeline. Templates path points to the Jinja2 email template folder.
_pma_comment: PMA NegotiationWatch. HubSpot writes are ASLEEP by default and require TWO affirmative switches: pma_hubspot_enabled:true here (master) AND running 'rocky.exe --pma-arm' (runtime arm flag). Either one absent = writes off. During the observe week leave both off: Rocky polls, classifies, and LOGS proposed updates only. '--pma-sleep' disarms.
_pma_mailbox_comment: pmateam@ is a Microsoft 365 Group (not a readable mailbox), so it forwards to rocky@. Rocky polls its OWN inbox and keeps only mail addressed (To/Cc) to pma_recipient_filter.
_pma_forwarder_comment: Senders whose mail is treated as PMA review material even when pma_recipient_filter is NOT in To/Cc — e.g. PMA negotiation emails forwarded in from the client. Matched on exact From address (case-insensitive).
_pma_corpus_comment: Knowledge corpus. Rocky saves every pmateam email + draft into per-deal folders under pma_team_root and synthesizes briefs daily via --pma-knowledge. Omit pma_team_root to default to a 'PMA Team' folder beside Rocky Cases on OneDrive.
_hubspot_property_comment: Confirm these internal property names via GET /crm/v3/properties/tickets before go-live. hubspot_summary_property is the custom 'Summary Status' field; the internal name may differ.
_pma_activity_comment: PMA Activity exporter (--pma-activity, once daily). Rocky pulls new emails from pma_activity_folder in pma_activity_mailbox and appends each (full body + extracted attachment text) as one JSONL line to pma_activity_feed.jsonl in maple_activity_dir, for the Maple Updater Agent to read. No classification/HubSpot/email. First run with no cursor backfills pma_activity_backfill_days. maple_activity_dir defaults IN CODE to the Rocky-laptop production path (under the rocky profile, same base as maple_logs_dir); override it here only on other machines (e.g. this dev-laptop value, under the jbragdon profile). rocky@ needs EDIT (not view-only) share access to the Maple updater agent folder to write the feed.
maple_activity_dir: C:\Users\jbragdon\OneDrive\OneDrive - gejlaw.com\Program Files\Maple\Maple updater agent\PMA Activity
_email_brain_comment: The Email Brain moved ENTIRELY to Minotaur 2026-08-02 — commands are now 'minotaur.py brain ...' and its config keys (sent_brain_*, voyage_*, email_brain_dir) live in C:\Minotaur\config.json (see Program Files\Minotaur\MINOTAUR.md). rocky.py no longer reads them; the deployed C:\Rocky\config.json may still carry them harmlessly, and Minotaur's setup command copies from there.
_vault_comment: The Vault (--vault, 3:00 PM daily). Shared team library of Remy-filing documents (leases, ledgers, affidavits of service) at vault_root — blank derives '<cases_root parent>\The Vault'. Pin the folder 'Always keep on this device' on the Rocky laptop. Sources: vault_inbox_mailbox (defaults to user_email — scanned for lease/ledger/affidavit attachments), vault_mailbox (defaults to rocky_email — any subject containing vault_subject_keyword is a team submission; everything attached gets filed and Rocky replies with where it went, gated by vault_confirmation_replies), and vault_dropbox_accounts. Reads use the app token (client_secret + Application Access Policy). First run backfills vault_backfill_days.
_vault_property_table_comment: Property grounding (2026-08-24): classification is grounded against Remy's property list (240 canonical community names) — the list rides in every classify prompt, and returned names snap to canonical spelling with a confidence floor when a tenant is also present. Default location is data\property_table.csv beside remy_cli_path; set vault_property_table to override; missing file just disables grounding. Since 2026-08-29 grounding ALSO reads The Vault\_vault\property_aliases.json on the share (variant->canonical aliases + supplemental known_properties) — that file, not config, is where property-name teaching lives.
_vault_move_comment: Processed mail leaves ROCKY'S inbox only (2026-08-24): vault-mail submissions move to Inbox\The Vault in rocky@'s mailbox ("" disables). James's own inbox is NEVER touched by the Vault sweep — his decision 2026-08-24. (Same pattern: litigation_processed_folder -> Inbox\Litigation Updater, letterstream_processed_folder -> Inbox\Letterstream, both in rocky@'s mailbox.)
_multifamily_digest_comment: Multifamily Digest (--multifamily-digest, 5:30 PM daily — dashboard 'Multifamily Digest'). ONE daily DRAFT in James's Drafts folder (multifamily_digest_mailbox, default user_email) pre-addressed to the multifamily group — James reviews and sends, same model as the Maple Digest (changed 2026-08-29; Rocky no longer emails it from rocky@, and the old multifamily_digest_recipients / vault_digest_recipients keys are ignored). Sections: certified mail sent through LetterStream (requested/released/mailed with costs and approvers), affidavits drafted/filed/declined, the day's Vault additions, Remy development, and a snapshot of everything still pending. SUBSUMES the standalone Vault Digest — don't schedule both. Quiet day = no draft. OMIT multifamily_digest_draft_recipients to use the built-in group list (Mondragon, Wenger, Ronan, Brown, Frantzis, Kobylski, O'Mara, Araviakis, Goranin); set it to override.
_multifamily_banner_comment: Masthead image for the Multifamily Digest email. OMIT the multifamily_digest_banner key to use the bundled Icon\multifamily_banner.png (the default — no config needed); set it to a path to override (must exist on the machine that runs the digest); set it to "" to disable the banner (plain text title instead).
_vault_digest_comment: Vault Digest (--vault-digest). SUPERSEDED by the Multifamily Digest (which includes the same Vault section); the command still works for manual use.
_vault_dropbox_comment: Each entry is one Dropbox login to pull from. Create an app at dropbox.com/developers/apps (scoped access; permissions files.metadata.read + files.content.read + sharing.read), paste app_key/app_secret here, then run 'rocky.exe --vault --dropbox-auth <name>' once to get the refresh_token. folders are paths in that account's own Dropbox ('' = entire accessible root; app-folder apps see only their folder); omit folders entirely for a link-only account. shared_links are shared-FOLDER links from anyone (rlkey and all query params kept intact) — the token just needs to be any authorized Dropbox login, e.g. James's own, so ONE app covers every client's shared link; description feeds the classifier context. max_files_per_run (default 200) throttles big first pulls — cursors/marks hold so the rest arrives on later runs.

vault_dropbox_accounts.name: james-dropbox

shared_links.name: rad-notices
shared_links.description: DC RAD-stamped notices supporting Remy complaint drafting

vault_dropbox_accounts._max_age_comment: max_age_days (per link, or account-wide) skips files whose Dropbox modified date is older — e.g. 183 = only the last ~6 months. CLI --max-age-days overrides for one run.

_affidavit_comment: LetterStream process (--letterstream, legacy alias --affidavits; 8:00 AM daily; renamed from Mailing Affidavits 2026-08-23 — it also sends mailings without affidavits; the affidavit_* key names are unchanged). Generates the Certified Mailing Affidavit from a LetterStream proof-of-mailing PDF and emails it to affidavit_approver (Hailey) for a YES/NO reply; YES files the affidavit + proof into The Vault. letterstream_api_id/key come from My Account > API Information after LetterStream activates API access. IMPORTANT: LetterStream's documented API (Feb 2023) has NO job-list call, so discovery is '--letterstream --fetch <certified tracking #>' (proof pulled via the API) or '--letterstream --ingest <proof.pdf>' (downloaded by hand); if support ever provides a list call, put its POST params in letterstream_list_params (e.g. {"action": "..."}) and the 8 AM pull becomes automatic — see LETTERSTREAM.md. '--letterstream --probe' verifies auth (accountstatus). affidavit_root blank derives '<cases_root parent>\Mailing Affidavits' (pin it on the Rocky laptop). affidavit_cc is added to every approval email (default: James). affidavit_pdf: convert the approved affidavit to PDF via Word before vaulting (needs Word on the machine; falls back to the .docx).
_affidavit_submit_comment: Primary discovery channel (LetterStream confirmed 2026-08-16 that the API can't list or serve proofs for website-submitted jobs): any firm sender emails rocky@ with affidavit_subject_keyword in the subject and the proof-of-mailing PDF(s) from the LetterStream job page attached; the 8 AM sweep turns each into an affidavit sent for approval and replies to the submitter.
_mail_submit_comment: Outbound: Rocky submits certified mail through the LetterStream API. A firm sender emails rocky@ with mail_request_keyword in the subject + ONE PDF (the complete packet); Rocky preauths on LetterStream (nothing bills), emails the requester the recipient + page count + quoted cost tagged [CM-####]; YES from the requester or James releases it (the billing step). mail_max_cost caps the LetterStream quote. mail_from = the firm return address printed on the envelope/coversheet (defaults in code to the Baltimore office). letterstream_mailtype: 'certified' (with Electronic Return Receipt) or 'certnoerr' (without). Once mailed, the proof is pulled via the API and the affidavit flows automatically.
_letterstream_extra_comment: Extra POST fields merged into every job submission — the hook for options the Feb 2023 API doc doesn't cover. Pending answer from LetterStream support: the field name for EXPEDITED production (the website's expedite option), which the firm wants as the default; when support names it, add it here (e.g. {"expedite": "1"}) — no rebuild needed. Uploads/job names follow the firm convention 'LastName Matter#' (matter number extracted from the request email; job names carry a short unique suffix).
_litigation_comment: Litigation Updater (--litigation). Bozzuto claims tracking on Smartsheet. smartsheet_token: a Smartsheet API access token (Account > Apps & Integrations > API Access) from an account with access to both sheets. Sheet IDs: File > Properties on each sheet. litigation_root holds the shared data (activity/comms logs, brain.md, voices, report template, the Litigation Update Vault, Reports) — pin it 'Always keep on this device'. Column names are matched by TITLE, so set litigation_entity_column / litigation_closure_column / litigation_disclosure_column / litigation_update_columns to your actual column titles; litigation_update_columns lists the columns updates are normally written into (empty = let Claude use any non-primary column). litigation_entities maps report keys to entity names (report requests: --report BMC or a Teams message 'run a litigation update for BMC'). litigation_audit_reports_dir: folder of PAST audit reports (.docx/.pdf) that teach the third-party-disclosure voice. litigation_summary_column: the internal claim-summary narrative column ('Summary of Claim') — teaches the summary voice. Exemplar documents dropped in <litigation_root>\_litigation\voices\seeds\<updates|summary|closure|disclosure>\ are folded into that voice on every --voice-rebuild as gold-standard references. litigation_notice_senders: mail from (or forwarded from) these addresses is treated as a new legal notice. After a YES executes, the source mail is moved out of rocky@'s inbox into the litigation_processed_folder subfolder (created under the Inbox if missing; set to "" to disable). litigation_mail_move_via: "delegated" (default — rocky@'s cached sign-in, Mail.ReadWrite.Shared, consented 2026-07-05) or "app" (needs Mail.ReadWrite Application). The Teams chat is a persistent group chat titled litigation_chat_topic between rocky@ and litigation_chat_owner (default user_email); litigation_observers may watch but never decide.
_litigation_sheets_comment: TWO open sheets share one closed sheet. Each open-sheet entry: key (shown in chat/logs), sheet_id, entities (routes NEW claims — an incoming notice for one of these entities lands on this sheet), claim_column (the sheet's claim-identifier column), and column_map additions (open->closed title translations layered over the global litigation_column_map). The BCC/BDC master ('BCC_BDC Litigation Report - MASTER', verified 2026-08-02) uses 'Project' where the BMC master uses 'Property Name (State)', and 'Combined Claimant/Project' like the closed sheet. (Legacy single-sheet key litigation_open_sheet_id still works if litigation_open_sheets is absent.)
_litigation_columns_comment: Column titles below match the 'BMC Litigation Report - MASTER' sheet (verified 2026-08-02): Entity | Claimant | Last Name of Claimant (if applicable) | Date of Loss/Filing | Property Name (State) | Combined Claimant (Project) | Type of Case | Summary of Claim | Attorneys | Status/Action Items | Exposure | Exposure/Analysis | Estimated Settlement Expense | Estimated Attorneys' Fees | Court/Agency | Case No. | Date Filed | List of All Defendants | Third Party Disclosure Summary | Overall Status. litigation_claim_column names a claim for correlation/vault/chat. Entity cells hold 'BMC' plus variants like 'B&A d/b/a The Bozzuto Group' — the match lists cover them.
_litigation_closed_comment: Closed sheet ('Closed Claims - MASTER', verified 2026-08-02) mirrors the open sheet plus 'Date Closed' and 'Closure Notes', but three titles drifted — litigation_column_map translates open-sheet titles to closed-sheet titles when a claim moves. Date Closed is auto-set to the move date when the drafted note doesn't carry one.
_inbox_cleaner_comment: Inbox Cleaner (--inbox-<key>, e.g. --inbox-matt). Per-user inbox triage that becomes a permanent rule-learning maintenance process. Each key under inbox_users is a process name suffix (inbox-matt, inbox-paul, ...). mailbox must be covered by the Application Access Policy (IT adds it — see INBOX_CLEANER.md). chat_upn defaults to mailbox. Tunables: age_floor_days (case + internal cohorts; newsletters have none), big_cluster_min (thread size before it's 'a big case'), newsletter_min_count / newsletter_max_read_rate (bulk-sender heuristics). inbox_cleaner_dir = the human-facing share folder (rules.md, cohorts, activity + communications logs, review workbook); standard location is 'Rocky Inboxes' under OneDrive Program Files\Rocky (already pinned/synced on the laptop; set the machine's own profile path). Blank = fallback to a 'Rocky Inboxes' folder beside Rocky Cases. Snapshot/moves logs stay LOCAL under C:\Rocky\inbox_cleaner\<key>.
_inbox_observers_comment: observers: extra people in the user's Teams approval chat (group chat instead of 1:1) who can watch and comment — but ONLY the mailbox owner's replies count as approvals. Omit the key to default to [user_email] (James). Set to [] for a true 1:1.
_inbox_write_via_comment: write_via: how --execute authenticates. 'app' (default) = application token, needs Mail.ReadWrite (Application) + admin consent, fenced by the Application Access Policy. 'delegated' = rocky@'s own delegated token (Mail.ReadWrite.Shared, already consented), needs only an Exchange Full Access delegation on the target mailbox — the lighter IT ask, chosen for Matt.
